what: FAN WIDTH — the two saturation curves and the latency they buy

thresholds.saturation: smallest N with paired-vs-Nmax NOT separated AND |delta| <= sat_tol_m
thresholds.registered_prediction: O1 SELECTOR-BOUND with N*(selected) <= 32 and N*(oracle) 128/256 or unreached (possibly O4); P2: R2 at wide N, R1 below ~16

C-monotone-oracle.why_it_can_fire: oracle_in_fan is a min over a GROWING nested set, so an increase is impossible unless the code is wrong. This is a check on my own pipeline.

C-full-rung.direction_predicate: BETTER than published is as much a FAIL as worse — a two-sided |dev| test, not one-sided
C-full-rung.red_flag: beating published by > 0.1 m => leak audit, do not publish

C-random-subset.direction_predicate: FPS prefix must be <= random on oracle at >= 7 of 9 rungs

C-stride.status: REPORTED — no verdict rides on it (prereg §5)

C-band-fidelity.trigger: > 20% of pairs admitted by the anchor band but rejected by the decoded band => P2b's saving is illusory

P2.band: v_mean in [max(0, v0 - 5.0), v0 + 5.0] m/s — flagship_v15's OWN clamp via refc_select, NOT tuned
P2.⛔: the clamp's ADE-inertness at full width is ALREADY MEASURED (paired delta exactly 0.0) and is NOT re-reported here as a finding. The registered question is what its freed budget buys.

selected_ade.note: N_star None = never satisfied on this ladder, i.e. the metric is still moving at the widest fan we have (O4)

oracle_in_fan.note: N_star None = never satisfied on this ladder, i.e. the metric is still moving at the widest fan we have (O4)

saturation.⛔: reporting one of these without the other is out of contract — the GAP between them is the question

rho_hygiene.⛔: rho over the full candidate axis is NOT a proxy for a selector; restricted to survivors one rho in this programme went 0.6657 -> 0.3008 and another crossed zero. Both are printed beside the selection ADE, always.

four_families._dt_provenance: derived from wp_steps [5, 10, 15, 20] x dt_s 0.1 -> 0.5s grid

ego_progress.t0_axis_gt_self_ratio_note: what the GROUND TRUTH scores under pseudosim's published t0-axis reading. 1.0 means the windows are straight; below 1.0 is the CURVATURE CONFOUND — the human charged for under-progress it did not commit, and an arm that drives straighter than the human rewarded for it.
ego_progress.definition: along-track distance covered / the human's, both projected on the human's own final-displacement direction; dt-invariant; <1 = under-drives, >1 = over-drives; GT scores exactly 1.0 by construction
ego_progress.published_motivation: arXiv 2605.00066 — Ego Progress alone rho=0.83 vs closed-loop Driving Score while traditional L2 gives rho=-0.36 (p=0.43, n=8, NO CI). Direction only; those magnitudes are NOT a target.
